item.summary: fix(announce): report unknown token usage instead of zero on the stats line (#126976) * fix(announce): report unknown token usage instead of zero on the stats line buildCompactAnnounceStatsLine collapsed "token data absent" into "token data is zero". Both states rendered as `tokens 0 (in 0 / out 0)`, so a child whose usage had not been flushed to its session entry announced as though it had done no work. In the openclaw-kkv1 incident the line `runtime 1h30m • tokens 0 (in 0 / out 0)` was part of what made a still-running child look dead; kkv1 fixed the surrounding status/result wording and deliberately left the stats line alone. This is that leftover. There are three states, not two: usage absent (no inputTokens, no outputTokens, and no fresh session total), usage present and genuinely zero (a child that never made a model call), and usage present and non-zero. The fix is not to swap the zero default — `tokens 0 (in 0 / out 0)` is truthful in the second state and must be preserved.
